part1.title: Zombie Outbreak Day 3: Stealing Fuel At Midnight, Don't Start The Pump (1/3) #shorts
part1.description:
If you need fuel in an outbreak, don't start the pump. Sound carries farther over water. A siphon needs no power: keep the can lower than the tank and gravity does the rest.

Stay or go? Part 2 is up next.

part2.title: Zombie Outbreak Day 3: 60 Infected On The Pier And One Rusted Pin (2/3) #shorts
part2.description:
A floating dock hangs off the pier by one ramp and two steel pins. Pull them and the pier ends in open water. One pin is rusted solid, and 60 infected are 20 yards away.

Go back? Part 3 is up next.

part3.title: Zombie Outbreak Day 3: How To Kill A Generator In Seconds, With A Flip-Flop (3/3) #shorts
part3.description:
Every engine has to breathe. Block the air intake and it dies in seconds. No sound, no light, nothing for the infected to follow. And the stranger in the office knows Tess's mother.

Would you have gone back? Day 4 is tomorrow.
